findings.message: L442: 🔴 bug: sync `settings.docStoreConn.delete()` is called directly inside `nursery.start_soon` without wrapping in `trio.to_thread.run_sync`, so it blocks the entire event loop instead of running in a worker thread. Wrap the lambda body with `trio.to_thread.run_sync(...)`.

L204: 🔴 bug: `list.extend()` returns `None`, so `sorted(set(node0_attrs["source_id"].extend(...)))` always becomes `sorted(set(None))` → `[]`, silently erasing all prior `source_id` values. Replace `.extend(...)` with `+` or use a temporary list, e.g. `sorted(set(node0_attrs["source_id"] + node1_attrs.get("source_id", [])))`.
L215: 🔴 bug: Same `list.extend()`‑returns‑`None` pattern for both `keywords` and `source_id` on edge attrs, causing silent data loss. Use `list1 + list2` instead of `list1.extend(list2)`.

L114: 🔴 bug: `nx.connected_components()` returns sets of nodes, not a graph object – `sub_connect_graph.nodes()` does not exist and will raise `AttributeError`. Replace `sub_connect_graph.nodes()` with `sub_connect_graph` (already a set of node names).
